function.description: Check the selected Vex wallet's live Lighter onboarding readiness on Robinhood Chain (RHC) in ONE read-only call, fixed to RHC: wallet USDG on Robinhood Chain, native ETH for gas, collateral and account ownership, gateway allowance, deposit minimum, and local trading-credential readiness. When the user says they want to start or set up trading on RHC, call this immediately as the first and only tool in the batch; do not narrate or reason through setup before calling it. Prefer it for RHC setup, readiness, funding checks and 'can I deposit?' questions; do NOT run protocol discovery or a separate wallet-balance read first. Direct deposits are the exception: when the user names an amount to deposit or fund, skip this onboarding read and WalletBalances, use ToolSearch once to select lighter.deposit.prepare, and pass that amount unchanged. If the desktop setup handoff opens, the runtime ends the turn and the modal owns the flow; do not continue setup in chat. Otherwise answer directly from its deterministic result unless the call failed. Returns balances, account collateral, trading-key and managed-access readiness, a funding assessment with amounts and shortfalls, a plan of required legs, the next-step route with its toolId, and any named-trade minimum. Read-only: moves no funds, signs nothing, creates no approval, registers no key.
function.name: lighter_rhc_onboarding_status

amountIn.description: Optional target collateral for a named trade in human USDG decimals, for example "1". Requires marketId or marketSymbol, and is never a direct deposit or funding amount.

marketId.description: Optional Lighter RHC market id. Pass at most one of marketId or marketSymbol, with amountIn.

marketSymbol.description: Optional Lighter RHC market symbol, for example SUI. Pass at most one of marketSymbol or marketId, with amountIn.

walletAddress.description: Optional 0x-prefixed EVM wallet address to check. Omit to use the session's selected Vex wallet. Never a private key.
